target.title: fix(diffs): widen isLoopbackClientIp to full 127.0.0.0/8 loopback range
target.body:
## What

Changed `isLoopbackClientIp` in the diffs extension from exact `"127.0.0.1"` match to `clientIp.startsWith("127.")`, covering the full 127.0.0.0/8 loopback range.

## Why

The existing check only matched exact `127.0.0.1`, missing the full 127.0.0.0/8 loopback range. Container and sandbox environments commonly use other loopback addresses like `127.0.0.2`. The canonical implementation in `packages/net-policy/src/ip.ts` uses `ipaddr.js` range check which correctly covers the entire 127/8 range.

## Evidence

- **diffs tests**: 10 test files, 135 tests all pass
- **canonical implementation**: `src/gateway/net.ts` `isLoopbackHost` delegates to `isLoopbackIpAddress` which checks the full loopback range via `ipaddr.js`
